objective: Preserve valid JDs already supplied by job collectors before filtering strips them, persist them in the existing JD cache and report per-source availability without changing ranking or CV generation.
allowed_changes: Cache full collector JDs for eligible or review jobs before their public payloads are reduced by the existing filters
Reject obviously invalid collector descriptions and preserve longer cached versions
Expose per-source collector JD availability through existing search and catalog API responses and existing UI diagnostics
Add directly related regression tests without new dependencies or schema changes
forbidden_changes: automatic CV generation absent user click
ranking, local or AI scoring engines, model providers and score thresholds
CV generation, templates, profile facts and résumé scoring
search eligibility, filter criteria or candidate decisions
acceptance: Valid collector JDs are stored before the existing filter strips descriptions
Invalid or blocked-page descriptions are not cached
No new database tables, paid AI calls, schedulers, source collectors or generators
JD availability counts appear in the existing source diagnostics
Existing search, ranking, CV and decision flows are unchanged
Pass regression, UI/build and canary integration checks before production deployment
deployment: Scope contract update must be committed separately from implementation for the immutable-contract gate check; canary validation before production, main requires explicit permission.
